plan: Plan RoboDojo play_Xylophone using CURRENT RGB only. Goal: pick up mallet and strike all8 keys left-to-right, lifting the mallet at least25mm between hits. Native500 actions; no required extra home, fixed cleanup reserve, maximum view/recovery count, or policy finish. Local OpenCV/SciPy tools do ALL fine segmentation, contour extraction and geometry; local cuRobo operations do complete pickup and ordered strokes. DO NOT select boundary pixels or give XYZ/robot commands. Give ONLY coarse original-image bounding boxes and a high-level decomposition. Return {"stages":["identify","pickup","calibrate held head","eight lifted strokes"],"arm":"auto|left|right","views":{"head":{"head":[x0,y0,x1,y1],"handle":[...],"instrument":[...],"keys":[[...],...8 boxes...]},"wrist_l":{"head":null,"handle":null,"instrument":null},"wrist_r":{...}},"reason":"current evidence and uncertainties"}. head view=cam_head/cam_high; wrist_l=cam_left_wrist; wrist_r=cam_right_wrist. Keys are EIGHT individual colored bars in instructed left-to-right order, each box encloses its full long colored top and two white fasteners. Head is the striking sphere connected to shaft, not a key or reflection. Handle box should cover EXPOSED light wooden shaft suitable for grasp, excluding head and any support block where possible. Instrument box encloses all8 keys. Useful visible wrist boxes help; null is correct for invisible regions. Boxes can be rough: local tools refine them, no hand-drawn fine edges required. Describe a real alternative if recent measurement failed. Never request unavailable tools, reset physics or recommend stopping on uncertainty. Current local tools now refine head-to-TCP at each raised key checkpoint and use80mm physical lifts with observed-height correction. Those observations/operations run locally without model calls. No GPT-drawn boundary points are needed.
retention: Review CURRENT RGB after complete local shaft pickup/lift. Return {"holding":"held|empty|uncertain","reason":"specific current visual evidence"}. Held requires the actual mallet moving with fingers, not TCP motion alone. Empty means clear evidence mallet stayed on table or was dropped; local controller then regrips, NOT quits. Occlusion/uncertainty is advisory, does not block the next action. Local geometry calibrates head-to-TCP; do not draw boundaries or send low-level commands. Do not output finish/stop or arbitrary constraints.
review: The local executor has attempted eight measured lifted strokes but native has not yet ended. Review CURRENT RGB: return {"holding":"held|empty|uncertain","reason":"concrete issue: shifted grip, target offset, missed key or occlusion"}. Endpoint completion does not prove a native hit. Empty triggers reacquisition; otherwise local tools recalibrate and continue. Do not fabricate success, request new tools, or stop because a check failed. No cleanup reserve/home requirement.
recovery: A local geometry/motion operation failed; continue toward task from actual state. Return {"refresh_boxes":false,"reason":"specific suggested high-level correction"}; set refresh_boxes=true only if coarse semantic object regions are wrong and another planning query is needed. Actual available tools: local color/contour/shaft extraction, sphere fit, key-fastener stereo/common-plane fit, calibrated empty-arm view change, complete shaft pickup, current head tracking and lifted ordered strokes. The executor selects/replans real motions locally. Do not give fine boundary pixels, XYZ guesses, invented tools, stop/finish, fixed retry counts or protected-step reserves. Preserve possibly held mallet; an empty arm can obtain another view. Measurement quality should guide another measurement, not veto the whole task. Native500 and external150minutes are the only episode limits. Strike recovery first removes an empty observer from the loaded corridor and revises loaded wrist orientation/seed; do not repeatedly insert a viewing arm beside the carried shaft.
